tilts.set: SET on 2026-10-30 by the Portfolio Fitness for Fighting judg

industry.why: Double Underweight, carried unchanged. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): the United States consumer surveys fell again (University of Michigan 46.3 preliminary October, down 1.8; Conference Board 81.9 in September, down 6.7; Goldman Sachs 19 Oct), consumer discretionary lagged with technology and communication services in the week's rotation (Jefferies, 17 Oct), and the European consumer was again not read, so the row rests on the US reading and on the regime. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: D now, D prior, the largest industry in the universe at 138 stocks. Counter-case: Retail physical reads B and Online retail A on relative strength, Hotels C, which is where cheap good businesses accumulate, and a double notch on 138 stocks shuts bottom-up work out of the Lists; the exceptions are carried at sector level (H.3 Neutral).

sector.why: Underweight, carried, on the special topic 'The UK Budget of 28-Oct-26': a mayors' visitor levy from 2028 is a dated new headwind and 2027 UK growth was cut to 1.0%, against which the market disagreed on the day (Whitbread up 5.6%) and Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-30 against 2026-08-28, not week on week: B now, C prior, DISAGREES. Component 1 regime, 30-Oct-26 (risk-off beneath a steady index, led now by credit and the cost of debt rather than by the artificial intelligence wash-out alone: the US ten-year above 5% after a hawkish Fed hold with two dissents for a hike, Goldman Sachs' Risk Appetite Indicator at its lowest since April 2025, euro investment-grade and high-yield yields up 30 and 90 basis points since September, Brent near $115, the French premium a record 150 basis points, Europe rotating to quality, defensives and non-AI growth, the STOXX Europe 600 1.7% from its high with breadth recovering from the bottom fifth of three years and defensives leading cyclicals at four weeks and three months; sources present 2026-W44): discretionary spend under a split consumer (Conference Board up, Michigan second lowest on record) and no European consumer reading. Four Pool names. Counter-case: the small-business rates relief helps the high street and the tape is buying leisure. To C if a European consumer reading arrives not falling with relative strength holding B.

geography.why: Neutral, carried. No source spoke to Germany this week (a source pack is present, 2026-W43, and it carried nothing country-specific here), relative strength is not graded by country, and Richard's view is G10 and Europe-wide with no country line. An absence is an absence; no tilt.
